goal.text: Work through the whole laundry pile and confirm nothing has been left unfolded or stranded off to the side.

turns.text: Remind me how I got from the bedroom to here?

trigger.detail: C has just turned clockwise and sat down on the couch

expected_answer.text: You walked out of the bedroom, turned left along the hallway, then turned clockwise in the living area and sat down.

turns.text: On the way through — did I pass anything with a screen?

trigger.detail: gaze leaves the clothes in hand and sweeps off to the wall

expected_answer.text: Yes, a screen on your left about ten seconds in, just before you reached the couch and sat down.

turns.text: Oh — by the way, which hand started?

trigger.detail: the display dropped out of view as C turned into the living area

expected_answer.text: Your left hand first, on its own, and then both hands came in a few seconds later.

turns.text: Mm-hm... mm — sorry, carry on, I'm just going to keep working through these.

trigger.detail: user acknowledges mid-answer and hands the floor back

expected_answer.text: No problem. I'll keep watching and say something if a piece gets missed.

turns.text: Back to it: where have the finished ones been going?

trigger.detail: a folded piece has just been dropped forward and C has turned to her left

expected_answer.text: Onto the table in front of you. You lean forward and drop each folded piece there with your right hand.

turns.text: Is that the only place they're going, or did some end up next to me?

trigger.detail: C has finished dragging the packed clothing over on her left

expected_answer.text: Some are beside you as well. There were packed bundles on your left that you kept pulling closer, plus a pile on the floor.

turns.text: Did I ever get that lot off the floor?

trigger.detail: the item retrieved from the floor has been checked and folded

expected_answer.text: Yes. You leaned down and lifted it with your right hand, then straightened up and checked it across your lap.

turns.text: And this one I've just picked up — where did it come from?

trigger.detail: a folded piece is dropped on the table and a new one is lifted from the left

expected_answer.text: Off the couch on your left. You twisted round for it, then passed it across into your other hand.

turns.text: Hold on — I mean before that, was it one of the ones I pulled over earlier?

trigger.detail: user repairs her own question while the answer is still running

expected_answer.text: Yes, it came off that bundle you dragged across from your left about a minute into this.

turns.text: So am I done with the lot now?

trigger.detail: the final fold is completed on the lap

expected_answer.text: That was the last one. It's all folded and stacked on the table now.
